about: OpenVibe's public roadmap: the plain-language summary of what is being built next, synced into the Roadmap space on openvibe.community at every boot (server/forum/roadmap.js). Edit this file to change the roadmap; each item keeps its thread (by key), so replies and votes stay with it.

items.title: OpenVibe.Chat, on its own site
items.summary: Global chat, direct messages, rooms and your chat settings at [openvibe.chat](https://openvibe.chat), working with or without JavaScript and even while Live is down. Opened on 24 September 2026; rooms followed on 25 September.

items.title: OpenRestream: stream once, restream everywhere
items.summary: Stream once and OpenRestream forwards it to Twitch, YouTube, Kick and more, with keys, destinations and output health in one place at [openre.stream](https://openre.stream). Live streams through it by default since 9 October 2026.

items.title: OpenVibe.Tips and OpenVibe.VIP
items.summary: Tips, goals and paid messages for creators at [openvibe.tips](https://openvibe.tips), and creator memberships with perks recognised on every site at [openvibe.vip](https://openvibe.vip). Opened on 17 October 2026, when all money moved to the network's billing ledger, so every tip and membership is recorded exactly once.

items.title: OpenVibe.News and OpenVibe.Reviews
items.summary: News: AI briefs built from many outlets with every paragraph linked to its reports, tone and perspective views, a live wire grouped by story, and topic pages. Reviews: what reviewers and permitted sources say, with their sources, and the searches on every review site. AI writing is always labelled.

items.title: OpenVibe.Deals and OpenVibe.Coupons
items.summary: Deals from the community and permitted feeds, with the price, the shop that sells it and how fresh it is, shop pages and a crowdfunding search. Coupon codes checked by the people who use them, and the OpenVibe Companion browser extension, which tries codes at checkout and never touches referral links.

items.title: OpenVibe.Trade: watchlists and alerts
items.summary: Sourced market information from SEC filings: the numbers each company filed, AI briefs that cite every figure, watchlists and alerts. Information only: no custody and no orders.

items.title: OpenVibe.Host
items.summary: [openvibe.host](https://openvibe.host) compares hosting plans from providers' own APIs, every price dated and sourced. Domain prices for every ending a registrar lists (first year, renewal, transfer, five years) with a name check, offers from LowEndSpirit's Offers board, benchmarks people run on their own servers, and a console for your own servers on Linode, DigitalOcean, Vultr and Hetzner Cloud, all live since 19 October 2026.

items.title: Voice and video calls in OpenVibe.Chat
items.summary: Voice channels in OpenVibe.Chat servers, call rooms, and calls between two people: Call on a conversation at openvibe.chat or on someone's menu on OpenVibe.Live, answered on either site, with mute and up to eight people in a call.

items.title: Images on Community posts
items.summary: Attach up to four images to a thread or a reply, with or without JavaScript. They are stored in OpenVibe.Media like every other upload, with location and camera details removed first.

items.title: Categories, feature requests and this roadmap
items.summary: Feedback has categories (ideas, bugs, questions), requests you can vote on, and a status staff keep up to date. This Roadmap forum shows what is being built, with a thread for every item.

items.title: Forum boards, ratings and pastes in posts
items.summary: Forums can be classic boards, like vBulletin or SMF: a board index, topic tables with replies, views and the last post, and author panels beside every post with quotes. Or they can be feeds ranked by votes. Rate any post the Facepunch way (Agree, Winner, Funny, Informative, Friendly, Sympathy, Dumb, Disgusting, Bad reading, Late), attach pastes and images, and crosspost a thread from a forum to a feed.

items.title: See, download and delete your data
items.summary: Download everything OpenVibe holds about you in one export, or delete your account: every OpenVibe site takes part.

items.title: AI that writes the way you ask
items.summary: Set a style, a length and a perspective once on your account, and OpenVibe AI follows them whenever it writes something for you. Turn off "Keep what I ask AI" and it keeps neither your request nor a reusable copy of the answer.

items.title: Favourite tools on every device
items.summary: Star a tool on openvibe.tools or on your account page, and it leads your tools everywhere you sign in.

items.title: Sign out everywhere means everywhere
items.summary: Signing out everywhere, changing your password or a ban now reaches every OpenVibe site within seconds: older sign-ins stop working and open chat and game connections close.

items.title: Rename your channel without breaking links
items.summary: When you change your username, links to your old channel address forward to the new one, and nobody else can take your old name for six months.

items.title: Every VOD and clip checked and recoverable
items.summary: Recordings and clips are stored in more than one place and checked regularly. A video now plays only once a stored copy has been checked, holds keep evidence from being deleted or moved (clips follow their recording), and a monthly report lists stray files without touching them. Still to come: splitting very long recordings into parts, and repairing the few copies known to be damaged.

items.title: Community threads on Discord, and back
items.summary: New threads are already announced on Discord. Next: replies both ways, edits and deletions kept in step, with no loops.

items.title: OpenVibe.Rent: every rental site in one search
items.summary: One search opens Craigslist, Facebook Marketplace, Zillow, Apartments.com, Zumper and the other rental sites at your place and filters. Rent by city for 885 US cities from Census data, a fair-rent check for any listing, a board that keeps listings from any site, and affordable housing from HUD, at [openvibe.rent](https://openvibe.rent).

items.title: OpenVibe.Homes: buying, city by city
items.summary: Every for-sale site's search in one place, what homes are worth in 885 US cities, the FHFA price trend, each state's county property records and a mortgage calculator, linked both ways with Rent, at [openvibe.homes](https://openvibe.homes).

items.title: OpenVibe.Pics: share pictures
items.summary: Upload pictures, make albums, embed them anywhere, resize and convert them by URL, and write alt text yourself or with AI, at [openvibe.pics](https://openvibe.pics). Signed-out uploads come once the safety partners are in place.

items.title: OpenVibe.Video: uploads, recording and AI edits
items.summary: Upload or record in your browser, then let AI add captions, chapters and a summary or cut the pauses into a tighter video. Playlists hold uploads and Live recordings, at [openvibe.video](https://openvibe.video). Live's recording and clip pages move there on 19 October 2026.

items.title: OpenVibe.Download: your files and folder backup
items.summary: A private drive with share links, and a folder kept backed up by the openvibe-download command (only what changed), at [openvibe.download](https://openvibe.download).

items.title: The OpenVibe Companion browser extension
items.summary: Tries OpenVibe.Coupons codes at checkout without touching referral links, saves rental listings from any site to your Rent board and checks whether their rent is fair.

items.title: Servers and AI members in OpenVibe.Chat
items.summary: Servers with text and voice channels, roles and invite links; pictures in rooms; and AI members in group chats, each thinking with OpenVibe's AI or your own model, able to search OpenVibe and use small tools. Opened on 16 October 2026.

items.title: A household on OpenVibe.Food
items.summary: A shared pantry and meal plan for a household, filled by barcode, photo or receipt, and a household chat with an AI member that knows what is in the cupboard. Opened on 16 October 2026.

items.title: ARENA ALERT on OpenVibe.Live
items.summary: The Arena is a drama desk: rage quits, viewer crashes, meltdowns, comebacks, records and beefs from every stream, each story stating what was measured, with reactions, the Lolcow Index and the Clout Rankings. Streamers can keep themselves out. Opened on 16 October 2026; since 18 October a story names someone only when their whole name was said, and an AI headline never adds an accusation.

items.title: Sharper live transcripts
items.summary: Live streams, recordings and clips are transcribed with NVIDIA's Parakeet model on OpenVibe's own server: more of what was said, punctuated, as fast as before. Japanese and other languages keep the multilingual model. Since 16 October 2026.

items.title: Worlds and game services
items.summary: Build a world in the map editor and publish it for anyone to join from a browser, and give any game leaderboards, achievements and cloud saves through OpenVibe.Play and the SDK.

items.title: Quests on every site
items.summary: Quests across OpenVibe with badges and OpenCoins, Live's go-live setup as a quest series, and quests developers define for their own apps through the SDK.
